maddeler.e:
احتبسوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَبَسُوا (iḥtabasū) /iħ.ta.ba.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اُحْتُبِسُوا (uḥtubisū) /uħ.tu.bi.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اِحْتَبِسُوا (iḥtabisū) /iħ.ta.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
